name: Mofezolac

similar.name: Valdecoxib
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 3 other countries, first in 2005 — for serious skin reactions and heart harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: Based on a small computer model rather than human tests, Mofezolac received a high risk score of 77 for liver harm and a low risk score of 14 for heart harm [M]. The drug itself has no listed problems in these records [1][2]. However, a similar drug named Valdecoxib was pulled from the market in the United States and three other countries due to heart and skin-related harm [3]. Valdecoxib also carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest type of warning, in the United States [3].
